toegepas.voor: Skeur 'n derde stuk van die rand af en kyk
toegepas.na: Probeer om 'n derde stuk van die rand af te skeur en kyk
toegepas.rede_vinder: An order to tear the piece and then check whether it stays whole contradicts itself; 'probeer' matches the earlier 'probeer dit buig' and leaves the protected 'van die rand af' intact.
toegepas.fout: The order to tear a piece and then check whether it stays whole contradicts itself, since a strong material does not tear.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Probeer om ... te skeur' makes the instruction coherent, matches 'probeer dit buig' in the same lesson, and leaves the protected 'van die rand af' intact.

toegepas.voor: wanneer jy optel, buig of trek
toegepas.na: wanneer jy hulle optel, buig of trek
toegepas.rede_vinder: The transitive verbs need an object; the lesson's later sentence uses 'wanneer jy hulle optel' the same way.
toegepas.fout: 'wanneer jy optel' lacks its object and can be read as adding up numbers.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'hulle' gives the verbs their object, matches the later 'wanneer jy hulle optel', and changes nothing in meaning.

toegepas.voor: Nou het jy die glas beskryf en nie net een woord daaroor gesê nie.
toegepas.na: Nou het jy die glas met meer as een woord beskryf.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The 'and not just said one word about it' tail is clumsy; the shorter sentence says the same thing directly.
toegepas.fout: The negative tail 'en nie net een woord daaroor gesê nie' is clumsy for a closing sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The shorter sentence says the same thing directly and is easier for a Grade 4 reader, with no fact added or lost.

na_skrywer.voor: trek water by homself in en hou dit vas
na_skrywer.na: trek water in en hou dit vas
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'by homself' is wooden and adds nothing, since 'intrek' already means drawing into itself; belongs with the matching glossary change for 'absorberend', so apply both or neither.
na_skrywer.fout: 'by homself' is redundant and slightly wooden next to 'intrek'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The study sentence deliberately mirrors the 'absorberend' glossary definition, which only the writer may reword, so the pair must be changed together by the writer or not at all.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: water by homself intrek en dan nat word
na_skrywer.na: water intrek en dan nat word
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Same wooden 'by homself' as in the study text; apply together with that change so the two wordings stay alike.
na_skrywer.fout: 'by homself' is redundant and slightly wooden next to 'intrek'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, which goes through the writer for every lesson that uses it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Hard of sag; Styf of buigbaar; Sterk of swak; Waterdig of absorberend
vlae.teks: Druk op 'n droë stuk hout en jy maak geen duik daarin nie.
vlae.rede: Several sentences join an imperative to a clause with its own subject by 'en' without a comma; the imperative has no stated subject, so I left them as they are, but the reviewer may want to confirm the house reading of the AWS rule for this pattern.
